 The toxic row threatening Taylor & Travis’ marriage: ‘They don’t want to give up’
 Unfortunately, they’re the problem, it’s them when it comes to the row over their brand-new marital home
 @Getty Images by heat staff | Published on 28th October 2026 at 4.30pm Follow Heatworld on Google They have enough personal wealth to fund a small nation, and the kind of international fanfare that global leaders could only dream of. But sadly for Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce, they’re finding that their power and prestige do not actually extend to all corners of the world. In fact, they’re hitting a very real stumbling block much closer to home – at their brand-new mansion in Ohio, to be exact – and it’s having massive repercussions on their first year of what should otherwise be marital bliss.
 Last week, it was revealed that the newlyweds had become embroiled in a vicious row with their would-be neighbours over plans to develop the $5.35m mansion in Bratenahl, a small village just out of Cleveland. As per planning requests, Taylor, 36, and Travis, 37, are trying to build a six-foot fence – as well as a litany of towering trees - around the 21,000-square-foot property.
 The argument is that, with their privacy being such a vital commodity, they need to take drastic measures to feel safe and secure on home soil. But while the fence was initially approved, longtime residents have now banded together to contest the finer points of the couple’s plans – gathering in several housing meetings over the past few weeks to air their grievances and slam the famous pair for disrupting ‘the peace and quiet in Bratenahl’.
 At one such recent meeting, a resident raged, ‘There’s a new owner, who is an absentee owner, who is not going to be here’ – before Travis’ name was later confirmed as the homebuyer. Another complained, ‘The applicant has higher security needs than many people,’ adding that, even with a high fence, it wouldn’t ‘slow down a motivated able-bodied young person’ from getting a peek at the famous pair, prompting a barrage of drones to instead be sent to the quiet neighbourhood.
 A third outraged resident added, ‘This applicant may decide to sell her house next year – maybe move on and buy another house’, leaving all the cost and destruction of their work behind for those still living there to deal with, including an aggrieved next-door neighbour who would have to move an old shared sewer line to accommodate the new fence and trees.
 The newlyweds have become embroiled in a vicious row with their would-be neighbours © Getty Images So far, as things stand, a fence has been approved, and some trees, not all, have been given the nod to go ahead, but that hasn’t stopped the local housing association from getting louder in its complaints against the famous couple – even after Taylor and Travis’ representatives said they had paid their own money to fix the shared sewer.
 But, as our source explains, the whole fiasco is proving to be particularly embarrassing for Taylor in particular. Let’s remember, this is a superstar who values her universal likeability above all else. So, to be greeted with annoyance and suspicion from her soon-to-be neighbours is proving to be a real sticking point in her decision to move to Travis’ home state.
 ‘Taylor and Travis are genuinely very upset about this,’ says an insider close to the newly married pair, who also count Taylor’s condo in Nashville, her mansion in Beverly Hills, her two-story condo in New York, and her holiday home in Rhode Island, plus Travis’ mansion in Kansas, among their shared property portfolio. ‘The last thing they wanted was to have any sort of friction with their neighbours. They have tried so hard to make sure people would be happy - already paid for all sorts of work that might normally be split between the neighbours and, knowing Taylor, she’ll gladly pay for anything else that the neighbours might need as a result of the trees they are adding to their property.
 The whole fiasco is proving to be particularly embarrassing for superstar Taylor © Getty Images ‘It’s hard to feel welcome when this sort of sentiment is being expressed. Taylor and Travis are very intent on fixing this; they want to be seen as a positive thing for the neighbourhood. But if it can’t be resolved and it turns out people are just intent on being hateful, it’s conceivable that they’d give up and sell the place. That isn’t what they want - they are looking to raise their family there, so the hope is that this ugly start isn’t going to be the whole story.’
 Let’s remember, when Taylor and Travis got married earlier this year – gathering 1,100 guests, including the majority of Hollywood, to Madison Square Garden arena for the ceremony – they went out of their way to prove just how generous they could be. Indeed, despite effectively shutting down a massive chunk of New York City, they let their money soften the blow, paying for the closure of at least three blocks of the city, as well as funding a heavy police presence – which reportedly cost over $160k in total.
 In addition to that, the day before the wedding, they donated $26m to 20 national charities, including organisations in Cleveland – where Travis grew up – and in Taylor’s hometown of Reading, Pennsylvania. In the past, Taylor’s been able to let her glowing reputation, and altruistic generosity, get her what she wants, with little backlash. But this time, she’s finding her wants and needs are being met with a whole lot of hostility. And for a brand-new bride, it’s an unfortunate blow.
 A resident raged, ‘There’s a new owner, who is an absentee owner, who is not going to be here’ – before Travis’ name was later confirmed as the homebuyer © Getty Images ‘It's incredibly stressful; this isn’t just about wanting privacy from all the fans and lookie-loos - there are stalkers and genuine threats to their safety that they need to prepare for,’ we’re told. ‘It’s a little shocking to them that there’s no understanding of that - these changes aren’t cosmetic, they’re the difference between Taylor feeling safe in her home and being at risk.
 'The fact that no one has any empathy for that is disheartening, especially because they’ve tried to do everything possible to make sure no one would be put out by the changes. Yet somehow, it has turned into this huge battle. Having it be so public only adds more stress to the situation because it’s creating negative headlines right when her new album has just come out.
 'If this was any other neighbourhood, Taylor would likely opt to sell and move, but this house is so close to where Travis grew up. It’s very sentimental for him and he wants to live there and raise a family, so they’re prepared to do whatever it takes to make their neighbours happy.’
 Now, the couple have until next month to submit a revised plan – with the hope that, this time, their new neighbours will be more welcoming. Here’s hoping, for all involved, there’ll be no more Bad Blood on all sides.
